title.zh: 量测闭环：从电容值走到可靠性
title.en: Measurement loop: from capacitance to reliability

subtitle.zh: C、G、I、频率、温度与时间缺一不可
subtitle.en: C, G, I, frequency, temperature and time all matter

body.zh: 一次点测只能回答此刻多大，不能证明全窗口与全寿命合格
body.en: A single-point measurement gives the current value; it does not establish compliance over the full operating window and lifetime
• High frequency probes intrinsic dielectric response
• Too small gives poor signal-to-noise ratio

body.zh: • 选择线性区内合适幅度
body.en: • Choose a suitable amplitude in the linear range

body.zh: • 过慢可能引发损伤/漂移
• 温度影响电容、损耗与可靠性
body.en: • Temperature affects capacitance, loss and reliability

body.zh: • 寄生需正确去嵌与建模
• 结构差异带来系统性误差
应力过低可能看不出薄弱点；应力过高又可能改变或损伤被测结构
body.en: Insufficient stress can hide weak points; excessive stress can alter or damage the test structure

body.zh: 窗口内：放行并持续监控
body.en: Within window: release and continue monitoring

body.zh: 趋势预警：复核与加密监控
body.en: Trend warning: review and intensify monitoring

body.zh: 边界：生产WAT、器件建模与可靠性认证的测试结构和条件并不完全相同。
body.en: Scope: production WAT, device modeling and reliability qualification do not use identical test structures and conditions.
